ideas.title: Investigation into 2020 Election Interference
ideas.description: Investigate the ongoing FBI probe into potential election interference in Fulton County, Georgia, and other locations.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and examine potential connections between election officials, candidates, and outside organizations.
questions: Who are the key players involved?
What are the potential implications for election integrity?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover significant findings related to election integrity and potentially lead to high-profile indictments or convictions.

ideas.title: Internal Misconduct within Law Enforcement
ideas.description: Investigate the case of the ex-FBI task force agent who faced a misconduct investigation and payroll fraud complaint.
ideas.angle: Examine the extent of internal misconduct within law enforcement agencies and potential implications for public trust.
questions: What are the implications for accountability?
ideas.insight: This story could shed light on internal issues within law enforcement agencies and lead to calls for greater accountability and reform.
